sloka: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः ।गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान् हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे ।। ६.४१.४४ ।।।।
transliteration: te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śārdūlā iva daṁṣṭriṇaḥ ।gṛhītvā drumaśailāgrān hṛṣṭā yuddhāya tasthire ।। 6.41.44 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena along with Jambavan and a large army of Vanaras were posted in the centre not far from Rama at the west by Rama's order.
